title: ctenitis lanuginosa
intro: Ctenitis lanuginosa, commonly known as the woolly fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are said to aid in treating various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis lanuginosa are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, exhibit anti-cancer properties, and display analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
